Travel to [[Scoundrel's Rise]] and investigate what is driving the [[Skale]] towards the [[Ascalon Settlement]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Head to Scoundrel's Rise east of North Kryta Province. Find the cause of the undead's westward movement.
* [[Lord Timot]] is the source of the undead movement. Destroy him.
* Return to [[Captain Greywind]] [Skills] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Jeweled Chalice]]
** Energy +8 (Requires 6 [[Illusion Magic]])
** Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 5%)
** Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 5%)
* [[Earth Wand]]
** Earth Dmg: 7-13 (Requires 6 [[Earth Magic]])
** Damage +10% (while Hexed)
** Damage +10% (while Enchanted)

==Walkthrough==

[[File:Reversing the Skales.jpg|thumb|right|Map for the quest part starting in [[Scoundrel's Rise]]]]

Head east along the beach of North Kryta Province and enter Scoundrel's Rise. Just as you enter you will see [[Settlement Scout Drew]] (if he dies you cannot complete the quest until you [[zone]] somewhere, luckily he stands right next to a [[portal]]). He will point you in the direction of [[Lord Timot]], a zombie boss who you must kill to complete the quest. Proceed east until you can travel south into a dead-end swamp where the boss will be located. The route is guarded by 4 [[Executioner]]s who may prove difficult to take down if faced all at once. Timot himself can be found at the bottom of the path together with some [[Smoke Phantom]]s.

When you enter the dead-end swamp, Lord Timot and the Executioners will begin moving out towards you, leaving the rest of the undead behind. The Executioners move much more slowly than their Lord, passing them at the swamp's entrance, so you can wait for them to separate in order to kill Timot without his guardsmen. Once outside, Lord Timot will turn southeast and march towards the [[Gates of Kryta (outpost)|Gates of Kryta]], eventually becoming unreachable when he moves beyond the portal. Consider pre-clearing the large clump of enemies just east of the swamp entrance to make sure you can safely catch up with Lord Timot if you intend to let him move away from the Executioners before engaging him.

Once he is defeated, return to [[Captain Greywind]] for your reward.

;War in Kryta 
If you have [[War in Kryta]] content active, Lord Timot will spawn close to [[Joh the Hostile]] and his group, who will fight and kill Lord Timot if he comes too close, rendering you unable to complete the quest until you zone. You are advised to move to the area quickly to prevent this from happening.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Greywind
:''"It has become clear that the skale are being driven from their swamps by some undead menace moving in from '''Scoundrel's Rise''' to the east. Rather than slaughter endless droves of the skale, who seem to breed as quickly as we slay them, I think it would be best to go to Scoundrel's Rise and find whatever '''necromantic force''' is driving these undead our way. Well, not merely to find it, but to put an end to it, right?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Leave it to me.
|decline = I'd rather keep fighting the Skale.
|ask = '''Scoundrel's Rise''' lies east of here. The roads there might not be safe, but they should at least show you the way. Find whatever is driving the undead out of Scoundrel's Rise and destroy it! 
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Settlement Scout Drew
:''"It's good to see Captain Greywind found someone able enough for the task. I'm quick on my feet and I can scout well enough, but battle's not my forte, if you know what I mean. Listen, though, last night I saw something that might aid you. There's some sort of zombie commander, Lord Timot, who seems to be gathering the undead and sending them west. If you can take him down, I think our problems will be solved."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Greywind
:''"You found the source of our skale problem, then? That's good news. Good news, indeed."''

== Notes ==
*The reward focus item has the [[Stone Chakram]] skin, not [[Jeweled Chalice]].
*This is the earliest opportunity to obtain the skills [[Desecrate Enchantments]], [[Animate Bone Fiend]]  and [[Barbs]] in the Prophecies campaign, so consider bringing three [[Signet of Capture|Signets of Capture]] if you are a [[Necromancer]].
{{bug|Eventually, Timot will leave Scoundrel's Rise into Gates of Kryta, making the quest impossible to finish in the current [[instance]].}}
